items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the last set Sam Marowitz used to call tunes

ctx.x: They started pulling it out after Woody left for the night, like the last set Sam Marowitz used to call tunes and they started calling that, and they really liked playing it and Woody recorded it later.
Supposedly John Carisi originally wrote, “Israel,” for that band.
